implementation.name: Amiga 500 (Analogue Pocket, Mazamars312)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 131 HDL source files (14 systemverilog, 109 verilog, 8 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not setname-derived -- this core ships no MRA file. It reimplements the Commodore Amiga 500, giving machine_id a500, each checked against extract/machine.json. License: https://github.com/Mazamars312/Analogue-Amiga/blob/main/LICENSE is the verbatim GPLv3 text and the grant in https://github.com/Mazamars312/Analogue-Amiga/blob/main/src/fpga/MPU/substitute_mcu_apf.v says "or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-3.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 131 source files (14 systemverilog, 109 verilog, 8 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest dist/Cores/Mazamars312.Amiga/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier Mazamars312.Amiga.
